d: We are seeking a polished, client-focused Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) Sales Executive to represent the Genesis luxury automotive brand. In this role, you will deliver a bespoke, hospitality-driven purchasing experience for discerning buyers seeking Genesis Certified Pre-Owned vehicles. You will guide clients through vehicle selection, explain the rigorous Genesis CPO inspection and warranty standards, and build lasting relationships that reflect the brand's "Son-nim" (honored guest) philosophy.
q: Proven experience in automotive sales, preferably in certified pre-owned vehicles.
Strong negotiation skills and a customer-centric approach.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple tasks.
Familiarity with Genesis brand and a genuine passion for luxury automobiles is preferred.
r: Drive sales of certified pre-owned Genesis vehicles by building and maintaining strong customer relationships.
Provide exceptional customer service to enhance the buying experience and ensure customer satisfaction.
Conduct thorough vehicle presentations and demonstrations, highlighting features and benefits to potential buyers.
Collaborate with the marketing team to implement promotional strategies that drive traffic to the dealership.
Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of Genesis vehicle offerings, industry trends, and competitor products.
Assist customers with financing options and paperwork to facilitate the sales process.
Achieve and exceed monthly sales targets and performance metrics.
Participate in training and development programs to enhance product knowledge and sales skills.
